title: Fast Model Debias with Machine Unlearning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring counterfactual bias by altering the color of digit images in the Colored MNIST dataset and observing the resulting changes in model predictions.

Flipping gender attributes in images (CelebA) and tabular data (Adult Income) to measure counterfactual prediction differences, and computing Stereotype Scores (SS) on counterfactual sentence pairs for language models.
Flipping race attributes in tabular data (Adult Income) to measure counterfactual prediction differences, and computing Stereotype Scores (SS) on counterfactual sentence pairs for language models.
Evaluating Stereotype Scores (SS) and Language Modeling Scores (LMS) using counterfactual sentence pairs on large language models.
